items.title: Nvidia Board Launches Probe In CEO Jensen Huang Spying Case
items.summary: The Nvidia board has launched an independent probe in the wake of reporting that CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign espionage plot.

items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang admits to affair after allegations of romance with Chinese spy: Report
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly admitted to employees that he had an affair, following allegations of a romantic relationship with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.
